title: Evaluating Content Selection in Summarization: The Pyramid Method
authors: Ani Nenkova; Rebecca Passonneau
read_scope: PDF pp2-3 excerpts: content units, weighting and annotation criticism
problem: 内容选择缺少可复用参考
mechanism: 用语义内容单元和多参考出现频率衡量覆盖
evaluation_conditions: 多文档摘要、多份人写参考
limitations: 需要参考；频率不等于法律重要性
transfer_to_rapido: 复用固定要点；不虚构当前没有的多律师权重

title: Revisiting the Gold Standard: Grounding Summarization Evaluation with Robust Human Evaluation
authors: Yixin Liu; Alex Fabbri; Pengfei Liu; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp3-4 §3 ACU writing/matching and scoring
problem: 主观总体评分与长度混淆
mechanism: 先写原子内容单元，再匹配每个输出，另讨论长度影响
evaluation_conditions: 新闻及对话摘要、人类标注
limitations: 参考显著性仍有主观性；不是法律专家任务
transfer_to_rapido: 按问题/允许来源先冻结要点，同清单评价A0和C

title: Towards Question-Answering as an Automatic Metric for Evaluating the Content Quality of a Summary
authors: Daniel Deutsch; Tania Bedrax-Weiss; Dan Roth
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp3-4 excerpts of §3 question/answer/verification
problem: 主题词重合不代表同一信息
mechanism: 参考中提出问题，检查输出能否回答
evaluation_conditions: TAC、CNN/DailyMail；训练QA与问题生成模型
limitations: 自动问答和问题选择均会错
transfer_to_rapido: 用固定具体问题判断实际报告，不让被测报告自定考试题

title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
authors: Sewon Min; Kalpesh Krishna; Xinxi Lyu; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp2-3 incl §3.1 definition/assumptions/precision-not-recall caveat
problem: 一段话真假混合使二元评价失效
mechanism: 分解原子事实并计算来源支持比例
evaluation_conditions: 人物传记、Wikipedia、人类和自动来源核验
limitations: 只算precision；对冲突知识与辩论判断有假设
transfer_to_rapido: 保留来源归属、主张状态；必须配覆盖分，不能单用此分删内容

title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
authors: Tianyu Gao; Howard Yen; Jiatong Yu; Danqi Chen
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp3-4 §3 correctness and citation metrics
problem: 引用数量/存在不足以证明回答质量
mechanism: 正确性、引用覆盖及无关引用分开
evaluation_conditions: ASQA、QAMPARI、ELI5，检索与NLI评价
limitations: 引用支持不等于规则适用；NLI不是法律裁判
transfer_to_rapido: 语义回答分与引用分分开；错引应修局部，不使整段历史描述自动消失

title: Merging Facts, Crafting Fallacies: Evaluating the Contradictory Nature of Aggregated Factual Claims in Long-Form Generations
authors: Cheng-Han Chiang; Hung-yi Lee
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp2-3 method/setup excerpts
problem: 多个分别有依据的事实可混成错误实体传记
mechanism: 对共同指代的一组事实先做实体消歧再核验
evaluation_conditions: AmbigBio人物同名、Wikipedia检索、多种开源LM
limitations: 同名传记并非诉讼角色/阶段；实体消歧本身会错
transfer_to_rapido: 评价时核对同一原告/银行/法院的一致指代，原子分数不能代替整体绑定检查

title: FineSurE: Fine-grained Summarization Evaluation using LLMs
authors: Hwanjun Song; Hang Su; Igor Shalyminov; Jason Cai; Saab Mansour
read_scope: PDF pp2-5: §3 metrics/pipeline, §4 setup and Table1
problem: 整体Likert评分难定位事实、遗漏和冗长
mechanism: 分开做句子事实核对和keyfact对齐，计算faithfulness/completeness/conciseness
evaluation_conditions: FRANK与REALSumm新闻摘要；GPT-4-turbo等评价器与人类比较
limitations: 语义标签由LLM产生仍会错；非法律推导验收
transfer_to_rapido: 借其分开计分框架，加入角色、来源归属、法源和程序范围，不照搬自动判断为金标准

title: RARR: Researching and Revising What Language Models Say, Using Language Models
authors: Luyu Gao; Zhuyun Dai; Panupong Pasupat; et al.
read_scope: PDF pp2-4 task/attribution/preservation/approach; p6 setup/results
problem: 修事实时大改或删掉原内容
mechanism: 检索证据、问答一致性检查、最小范围编辑；同时评价归属和保留
evaluation_conditions: PaLM540B、NQ/StrategyQA/QReCC，web search和相关性模型
limitations: 归属不是正确；大模型/检索有额外成本；本轮不能开放查询隐藏结局
transfer_to_rapido: 把检索限制在允许库，局部编辑而非整段抹除；保留正确语义内容而非单纯字符相似

title: Attribute First, then Generate: Locally-attributable Grounded Text Generation
authors: Aviv Slobodkin; Eran Hirsch; Arie Cattan; Tal Schuster; Ido Dagan
read_scope: PDF pp2-6: §2-4 methods/setup and Table1-2
problem: 生成后补引用易错且核验上下文过宽
mechanism: 先选来源片段，规划句子，再生成；有prompt和finetune变体
evaluation_conditions: MDS与LFQA；Gemini ICL、PRIMERA微调
limitations: 不同任务和变体收益不一致；选段遗漏会限制覆盖；句子逐次生成有调用成本
transfer_to_rapido: 先选有角色和阶段的原句再写；保留全文补充通道；不照搬每句一次调用或原论文截断策略

title: Localizing Factual Inconsistencies in Attributable Text Generation
authors: Arie Cattan; Paul Roit; Shiyue Zhang; et al.
read_scope: PDF pp2-5 formalism/decomposition; pp8-9 annotation analysis and automatic classifiers excerpts
problem: 句子/自由文本事实仍混合正确与错误关系
mechanism: 用最小谓词—论元QA定位哪个参与者/原因/时间关系不受支持
evaluation_conditions: 摘要、传记、生成式搜索；人工QA标注、训练解析器、NLI/LLM
limitations: 定位协议并不自动修复；解析和核验模型仍有误差
transfer_to_rapido: 把谁认定/涉及谁/何阶段分开；当前只借表示，不新增训练解析器；针对错误关系生成局部修改

title: Fine-grained Hallucination Detection and Editing for Language Models
authors: Abhika Mishra; Akari Asai; Vidhisha Balachandran; et al.
read_scope: Official PDF metadata; arXiv PDF pp2-5 taxonomy/tasks/benchmark excerpts
problem: 二元事实标签不能指导不同错误修订
mechanism: 区分实体、关系、句子、编造、主观、不可验证错误，提出检测与编辑
evaluation_conditions: FAVAbench信息问答；训练专用模型；对比ChatGPT/Llama2
limitations: world knowledge核验权限不同；训练模型不可直接当原Qwen能力
transfer_to_rapido: 借错误类型和改写/标未知区分，不新增FAVA模型或用web答案补实验中间结果

title: PURR: Efficiently Editing Language Model Hallucinations by Denoising Language Model Corruptions
authors: Anthony Chen; Panupong Pasupat; Sameer Singh; Hongrae Lee; Kelvin Guu
publication_status: arXiv preprint; no formal venue verified
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp2-3 training overview/task/metrics/setup excerpts
problem: prompt逐证据编辑成本高
mechanism: 构造合成扰动，训练小型去噪编辑器
evaluation_conditions: T5/Fusion-in-Decoder；NQ/StrategyQA/QReCC，web证据
limitations: 依赖训练和域迁移；保留字符不等于语义正确
transfer_to_rapido: 提醒避免按事实数量线性增加调用；当前训练禁令下不采用其模型

title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
authors: Aman Madaan; Niket Tandon; Prakhar Gupta; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp2-3 algorithm and examples excerpts
problem: 一次生成可能不理想
mechanism: 同一LLM反馈与改写，多轮迭代
evaluation_conditions: 七类任务、GPT3.5/4，任务特定prompt
limitations: 不是所有任务的事实正确性证明；起始prompt和停止条件会混淆
transfer_to_rapido: 可借反馈格式，不能假定同Qwen多轮必改对；有限修订、同文返回要如实失败

title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
authors: Jie Huang; Xinyun Chen; Swaroop Mishra; et al.
read_scope: Proceedings metadata; arXiv PDF pp2-4 setup and oracle/intrinsic results excerpts
problem: 自纠增益可能来自oracle标签、弱初稿或额外计算
mechanism: 移除标准答案反馈，审查prompt与成本对照
evaluation_conditions: GSM8K/CSQA/HotpotQA，GPT和Llama2
limitations: 研究主要是无外部反馈推理，不能直接推出来源开放核验都无效
transfer_to_rapido: 不把反复ACCEPT当独立证据；本任务有来源，应直接测真实反馈收益和保留损失

title: When Can LLMs Actually Correct Their Own Mistakes? A Critical Survey of Self-Correction of LLMs
authors: Ryo Kamoi; Yusen Zhang; Nan Zhang; Jiawei Han; Rui Zhang
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp3/4/6/10 excerpts: taxonomy, RQs, feedback and comparison conditions
problem: 自纠文献的研究问题与公平性经常混杂
mechanism: 按反馈来源、初始答案条件和oracle信息分类
evaluation_conditions: 跨多类推理、代码和知识生成文献的批评性综述
limitations: 综述结论不是2026Qwen在本任务实测
transfer_to_rapido: 把改写收益、额外信息收益和完整系统效果分开；A0按用户规定不加机制，成本差异照报

title: On Improving Summarization Factual Consistency from Natural Language Feedback
authors: Yixin Liu; Budhaditya Deb; Milagro Teruel; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF p3 annotation pipeline; p6 editing/human evaluation and zero-shot case study excerpts
problem: 知道有错不等于能按要求改文
mechanism: 来源证据、错误解释、操作指令、最小编辑分开记录
evaluation_conditions: XSum/PEGASUS、人类反馈、微调编辑器及GPT3.5零样本
limitations: 人类反馈不能假设本项目已拥有；零样本可控编辑仍有限
transfer_to_rapido: 反馈必须绑定具体正文范围；记录是否真改、正确内容是否保留，不能把删段算修复

title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
authors: Shehzaad Dhuliawala; Mojtaba Komeili; Jing Xu; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp3-4 factoring/verification; Llama65B setup located
problem: 核验直接看草稿可能重复草稿错误
mechanism: 先提问，再不看草稿独立回答，再整合修改
evaluation_conditions: Llama65B、Wikidata列表/MultiSpanQA/长文；不研究工具检索
limitations: 仍是同模型知识，不是独立事实证据；拆分会增加调用
transfer_to_rapido: 在允许原文内先答具体关系QA，避免要求确认候选；成批处理但不能混入候选结论

title: The FACTS Grounding Leaderboard: Benchmarking LLMs Ability to Ground Responses to Long-Form Input
authors: Alon Jacovi; Andrew Wang; Chris Alberti; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp3-4 data examples/QA exclusions; scoring description in abstract
problem: 只看有无幻觉会让无用回答占优
mechanism: 先核对是否满足用户任务，再判断是否受给定文档支持
evaluation_conditions: 给定长文、企业领域、多个模型裁判
limitations: 数据特意避免复杂逻辑/专业法律推理；不可拿来证明法律效果
transfer_to_rapido: 同时判断回答了问题没有；本项目用连续覆盖分避免再次只剩整案二元分

title: The FACTS Leaderboard: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Large Language Model Factuality
authors: Aileen Cheng; Alon Jacovi; Amir Globerson; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp2/4 excerpts, four settings and essential/nonessential rubric example
problem: 不同知识条件下的事实性不可混为一谈
mechanism: 分开给定来源、参数知识、搜索和多模态条件
evaluation_conditions: 四类benchmark及grounding v2；多模型评价
limitations: 多模态示例不是本案文本实验；不直接迁移榜单数值
transfer_to_rapido: 明确本案只评允许来源，不拿现实中碰巧正确的隐藏结局加分

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
authors: Lianmin Zheng; Wei-Lin Chiang; Ying Sheng; et al.
read_scope: Abstract; PDF pp3-5 evaluator variants and bias experiments excerpts
problem: 偏好评分受顺序、长度、自偏好影响
mechanism: 研究匿名偏好与模型裁判，交换顺序和参考辅助
evaluation_conditions: MTBench/Arena；GPT/Claude等与人类比较
limitations: 偏好一致性不等于法律正确；自动裁判仍会错误
transfer_to_rapido: 匿名、交换顺序、来源定位、保留分歧，不让内部ACCEPT当得分

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge: Concerning Rubric Artifacts in LLM-based Automated Text Generation Evaluation
authors: Anshul Bagaria; Sowmya S Sundaram; Gokul S Krishnan; Balaraman Ravindran
publication_status: arXiv; authors state EMNLP2026 acceptance, proceedings not verified
read_scope: PDF pp1/2/4/5 excerpts: rubric-only probe, counterfactual analysis, noncausal limitation
problem: 有rubric仍可能不是按回答内容评价
mechanism: 只看rubric的标签预测及反转回答/准则检验
evaluation_conditions: HealthBench/ResearchRubrics，Qwen2.5/Gemma/Llama裁判等
limitations: 关联不证明因果；反转样本质量和领域均限制外推
transfer_to_rapido: 新增可复算分数仍需查标签；未来评价器需测真正的内容/关系变化敏感性
